objective_1.llm_guidance: First challenge objective shown as a checkable item. Start with an action verb. E.g. 'Complete all 10 rounds without a single error'. Keep under 12 words.

objective_2.llm_guidance: Second challenge objective. Start with an action verb. Should feel like a distinct, harder sub-goal. E.g. 'Maintain a response time under 3 seconds per round'. Under 12 words.

objective_3.llm_guidance: Third challenge objective. The hardest or most prestigious goal. E.g. 'Achieve a perfect score to unlock Elite rank'. Under 12 words.

timer_label.llm_guidance: Label above the countdown timer display.

reward_label.llm_guidance: Small label above the reward value in the reward card.

reward_value.llm_guidance: The reward amount or title displayed prominently in the reward card. E.g. '5,000 XP', 'Gold Tier Badge', '+2,500 Points'. Should feel valuable and specific.

eyebrow_label.llm_guidance: Short uppercase eyebrow label above the main title. Sets the competitive context. E.g. 'Enter the Arena', 'The Gauntlet Awaits', 'Live Challenges'. Keep under 5 words.

hero_subtitle.llm_guidance: 1-2 sentence subtitle below the hero title. Should convey the competitive stakes and energy of the platform. Speak directly to the competitor. Max 30 words.

progress_label.llm_guidance: Label above the progress bar. Override if the site uses different terminology.

timer_sublabel.llm_guidance: Small text below the timer digits. E.g. 'Until Round Closes', 'Challenge Window', 'Time Limit'.

challenge_title.llm_guidance: The name of the featured/active challenge displayed in the main panel. Should sound intense and specific. E.g. 'Speed Execution Trial', 'The Iron Logic Gauntlet', 'Rapid-Fire Decision Blitz'. 3-7 words.

cta_enter_label.llm_guidance: Primary CTA button text. Should be action-oriented and match the site's competitive tone. E.g. 'Enter the Gauntlet', 'Accept Challenge', 'Begin Now'.

hero_title_plain.llm_guidance: First part of the main hero title (rendered in white). This is the setup word or phrase before the accented word. E.g. 'Prove Your', 'Conquer the', 'Dominate the'. 2-4 words.

cta_preview_label.llm_guidance: Secondary CTA button text. E.g. 'Preview Rules', 'View Details', 'Learn More'.

hero_title_accent.llm_guidance: The accented word or phrase in the hero title (rendered in primary/red). This is the power word. E.g. 'Gauntlet', 'Arena', 'Challenge'. 1-3 words maximum.

leaderboard_title.llm_guidance: Title label in the leaderboard card header.

timer_reset_label.llm_guidance: Label for the timer reset button.

timer_start_label.llm_guidance: Label for the timer start/pause button.

panel_active_label.llm_guidance: Small label in the challenge panel header. Override if the site uses different terminology.

reward_description.llm_guidance: Short description of what the reward unlocks or means. E.g. 'Awarded to top finishers — unlocks the Elite Competitor badge and leaderboard recognition.' Max 20 words.

stat_winrate_label.llm_guidance: Label under the win rate stat.

stat_streak_initial.llm_guidance: Override the current streak stat if the site has a specific number to show.

stat_completed_label.llm_guidance: Label under the completed challenges stat.

stat_winrate_initial.llm_guidance: Override the win rate stat. Include the % symbol. E.g. '42%'.

challenge_description.llm_guidance: 2-3 sentence description of what this challenge involves and what makes it difficult. Use active, urgent language. Describe the stakes and the skill being tested. Max 50 words.

timer_initial_display.llm_guidance: Initial timer display value before JS initializes. Should match the intended challenge duration in MM:SS format.

difficulty_badge_label.llm_guidance: Difficulty badge text shown in the challenge panel header. E.g. 'Elite', 'Hard', 'Extreme', 'Legendary'.

leaderboard_live_label.llm_guidance: Live indicator label in the leaderboard header.

stat_competitors_label.llm_guidance: Label under the competitors stat. Override if the site uses different terminology.

stat_completed_initial.llm_guidance: Override the completed challenges stat if the site has a specific number to show.

challenge_number_prefix.llm_guidance: Prefix before the challenge number. E.g. 'Challenge', 'Round', 'Stage'.

stat_competitors_initial.llm_guidance: Override the displayed competitor count stat if the site has a specific number to show.
